verdict.rationale: Postman's core docs confirm collections/folders (postman-docs-15,17,18,29) and rerunning via Postman CLI/Newman or CI/CD (postman-docs-19,32,42), directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of folder-level reruns and no first-party mention of nested folder organization specifics; some community reports (postman-comm-4, postman-comm-15) describe collection data loss tied to account/cloud sync issues, which slightly dents reliability confidence though they don't contradict the core organize/rerun feature.
